description: Find site apps and free playbooks (how-tos) by what the site needs, e.g. "contact form", "redirects", "404". Leave query empty to list everything. Every app has a category ({slug, name}); categories lists them all in catalog order, and category narrows the apps to one. Each app has stage ("beta": works, but things may still break; tell the owner before they buy; "stable" otherwise) and stage_note, price_text (a plain sentence like "$19 one-time, one site"), the exact amounts in cents (prices, price_list) and cloudflarePlan (the Cloudflare plan it needs: "free" means the Cloudflare free plan, not the price). The older field plan is deprecated: it repeats cloudflarePlan.

category.description: Only apps in this category, by slug (e.g. "forms-and-leads"); see categories in any answer.

query.description: What the site needs, in plain words.

name: search_catalog
title: Search apps and playbooks
